Theme

Town, shops & places · Money, work & business

pay verb

also pay on time, pay off a debt, pay out, payment

classical

Traupman 131

solvō, solvere, solvī, solūtum

verb, third conjugation

Other words

  • dēnumerō, dēnumerāre — count out, pay

    verb, first conjugation · also used · modern · Traupman 131

  • solūtiō, solūtiōnis f. — payment

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Cic. Off. 2.84: solūtiō rērum crēditārum (Lewis & Short); Traupman 358

Examples

  • ad diem solvere

    to pay on time (on the day fixed)Cic. Att. 16.16a.4: ut pecūniam reliquam Buthrōtiī ad diem solverent (Lewis & Short s.v. reliquus)

  • ad tempus (ad diem dictam) solvere

    to pay on timeTraupman 131

  • Cēterōs nummōs ad diem dictam solvam.

    I’ll pay you the rest of the money on time.Traupman 129

  • dēnumerāre alicui vīgintī dollarōs prō aliquā rē

    to pay someone twenty dollars for somethingTraupman 357

See also pay in instalments, money, change, how much is it?.
